title: MZ Build APKs for Your RPG Maker MV/ MZ Games – No Android Studio Needed!

posts.author: Anaryx_plugin
posts.body:
Hey RPG Maker devs!
I just released AG APK Builder, a simple desktop tool that lets you compile your RPG Maker MV/MZ projects into ready-to-install APKs—completely offline and portable!
No Android Studio required
Easy setup: just select your www folder, fill in game info, and click Build APK
Live progress and logs to monitor builds
Works on Windows 10/11
Perfect for sharing your games on mobile quickly and safely!
Download / More info:
https://anaryx-plugin.itch.io/ag-apk-builder-rpg-maker-mvmz
Feedback and bug reports are welcome—let’s make RPG Maker mobile deployment easier for everyone!
